brief: The punt to the eyot (c128). The island is the run's newest place and nobody can stand on it: the only way onto it is by water from the JETTY (128.4, 35; onJetty()), where overDeck()'s jetty visitors already stand for a while (a.stop at JETTY.x − 1.3). One count only, inline in the probe you write anyway (jetty stands/day and their dwell on HEAD, 10 seeds × 3 summer days — write the two numbers into the ledger and move on). Then: ONE punt moored at the jetty; in daylight, calm (windF < 0.5) and dry, a jetty visitor whose dwell allows it (priced at the CHOICE against their retire: the trip is ~1 h sim each way plus a stay) steps aboard, poles to the eyot's EAST shore (eyotShore; the channel and the rowboat's lane x 116.5–121.5 are never entered — the crossing runs x ≈ 127 → 126.2, rows 35 → 42, south of the deck rows 30..32), stands under the willow for 1–2 h sim (a.eyot; named 'someone on the eyot, under the willow'), poles back, and resumes their retrace. The punt is two draw items in the rowboat's idiom (drawBoat is the rowboat's: give the punt its own, hull + pole + figure), never under the deck; while it is out the mooring is empty. Swans already keep off the turf (offEyot) — make sure the punt's landing does not put a swan or a nesting duck ON the shore cell it lands at (the 0.9-cell law). __entities takes the punt and the a.eyot stander; one announce line as it pushes off.
successLooksLike: probes/punt.mjs, 10 seeds × 3 summer days: 1–3 crossings per day, 0 in rain, wind > 0.5 or after dark; the punt never within 1 cell of the rowboat or under DECK rows; every crossing returns (0 strandings — an a.eyot stander is never left when eastOpen() closes); swans 0 samples on the landing cell while the punt is at the shore; census PASS (the stander is an existing agent re-routed; a new roll only on the family's own stream). shots/b94-punt-*.png: pushing off, mid-channel, under the willow.
avoid: Do not add a second rowboat or move the rowboat's channel. Do not give the punt its own arrival source — it is a re-route of a jetty stander (the callIn/stayOn shape), priced at the choice. Do not let the punt cross the lane bridge's arches or the footbridge.
